art.title: Portrait of a Knight
art.why: A man in a polished breastplate and leg armour with a staff: the knight in armour (a sixteenth-century portrait, not Roland: say so).

art.title: Saint Martin Dividing His Cloak
art.why: The armoured soldier-saint cutting his cloak for a beggar: strength turned to the poor, the Peace of God's aim. A different work from El Greco's (used).

art.title: The Red Cross Knight
art.why: Spenser's knight of holiness in full armour with Fidelia (with the chalice) and her sister: the knight's arms bound to faith; Spenser is later than Llull, say so.

art.title: A Knight of the Golden Fleece
art.why: An older knight of a chivalric order, plainly dressed, resting on a cane: the gentle veteran. No NGA Chaucer pilgrims: flag.
No NGA medieval battle or sack found; later battles (La Hogue, Bunker's Hill) would mislead.
